summary.text: Jean Jeudy is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 23 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Jeudy has worked as a journalist and as host of TV Palmiste, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Jean Jeudy has served on the board of a United Way affiliate, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists him as winning the Hillsborough 10 general elections on November 6, 2018 and November 3, 2020, and the Hillsborough 23 general election on November 5, 2024.
Ballotpedia lists committee assignments for Jeudy beginning with the 2011-2012 legislative session, mostly the Executive Departments and Administration Committee.
His 2023-2024 assignment was the State-Federal Relations and Veterans Affairs Committee.
